description:
This song is about an old man I used to work with whom I considered a cautionary tale about the futility of “respectability politics”, And exploitation through capitalism. But through a rather “DuBoisian” narrative. Real shit, this man was my “Ghost of Christmas Future” If said Ghost was Stephen Warren from D’Jango Unchained.


Lyrics: https://youtu.be/N4iEl7m6BpQ?si=idO9cq96anAbndpG
